cand.title: HIV Science Geneva 2027 (HIVR4P 2027 + IAS 2027)
cand.organizationName: International AIDS Society and partner organizations
cand.excerpt: Best-ranked: direct airport venue plus explicit official MCI housing provider, pre-blocked rooms, contracted hotels and group bookings.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Ariane Brusselmans is IAS Director, Conferences: a relevant conference-leadership referral and relationship contact, not a verified hotel contract signatory. Jeanne Mencier is the named contact associated with jeanne.mencier@iasociety.org on the 2027 sponsorship page; relevant to sponsor/delegation introductions, not verified as housing buyer. Her precise job title is not published there. No individual MCI 2027 housing contracting manager is publicly identified in the material reviewed. Start operational accommodation discussions with the published MCI team rather than scientific committee chairs.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming within the requested horizon: HIV Science Geneva 2027, Geneva, Switzerland, 10–15 July 2027. HIVR4P runs 10–12 July; IAS runs 12–15 July; 12 July is a shared bridge day, not two separate non-overlapping stays. These are activity dates, not announcement dates. Both use Palexpo. No subsequent officially announced edition with exact dates/city/venue was found; do not project a future Geneva return.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL product constraints: conditional fit for a proposed 20–120-room delegation or supplier/team allocation, not the entire congress and not a claim of existing demand. The current IAS page expects around 5,000 attendees; a 250-theatre hotel cannot host that programme. Palexpo’s airport-side location gives a more plausible lodging rationale than a downtown-only event, but Founex is still off-site in Vaud. Quote a credible door-to-door transfer plan and full landed price before pitching. Rooftop/F&B and small private meetings are secondary possibilities only, subject to organizer approval and scheduling; no such booking is evidenced. No resort-retreat requirement is published.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially announced venue: Palexpo congress centre and Halls 2 and 3, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, not Lausanne, and not downtown Geneva. Palexpo is a congress/exhibition venue, not an incumbent hotel. Public venue commitment is verified; the underlying venue contract was not inspected.
findings.historicalRotation: IAS rotated Brisbane (2023) → Kigali (2025) → Geneva (2027). HIVR4P rotated Chicago (2016) → Madrid (2018) → virtual (2021; Cape Town plan replaced) → Lima (2024) → Geneva (2027). Both series have published biennial descriptions, but HIVR4P actual intervals have varied. This does not establish annual Geneva demand or recurrence of the combined Geneva format. Historical hotel venues are not evidence of 2027 hotel inventory.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific official housing bureau: MCI Suisse SA. Exact wording: “the Accommodation team (MCI Suisse SA, the official housing provider for HIV Science Geneva 2027), has pre-blocked hotel rooms in Geneva.” The page also says “Stay at one of our officially contracted hotels” with special rates negotiated by MCI. EVERY named contracted hotel in the published material reviewed: none; no hotel names, individual block allocations, peak rooms or room nights are disclosed. This is contracted inventory with unnamed suppliers, not an absence of commitments. Delegate accommodation bookings open 17 November 2026, one day after the research reference date; this is not a hotel-supplier RFP opening. Groups can book two or more rooms. Nuitée is a separate alternative dynamic-rate platform, up to five rooms per reservation, not proof of contracted conference blocks. No open hotel procurement RFP found. Published operational contact: accommodation@iasociety.org; +41 22 339 9601. Hotels cannot accept changes/cancellations directly; MCI manages the process.
findings.organizationStructure: IAS – the International AIDS Society – is the organizer, identified in official terms as a Swiss non-governmental organization. This is an association/NGO-led scientific conference, not a government-owned event, notwithstanding the seed segment. MCI Suisse SA is the outsourced official housing provider, not the event owner. Palexpo is the venue. Terms separately identify K.I.T. Group as the registration team. No evidence establishes MCI as the overall event PCO or as holding every event procurement decision.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Existing MCI contracted hotels and pre-blocked inventory are a real competitive constraint, but their names and allocation volumes are unpublished in the reviewed material. HIVR4P sponsorship includes “Preferential selection for hotel room block” at certain sponsor tiers; this is not a hotel supplier opening or proof of a specific hotel commitment. Official conference hotels booked through MCI include a digital Geneva Transport Card. Do not promise that a Founex stay or the whole transfer is covered by that benefit. No sell-out, displaced room demand, overflow requirement, YOTEL inclusion/exclusion, or shortage evidence was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact MCI’s accommodation team now with a concise supplier capability enquiry, explicitly asking whether additions to the 2027 contracted portfolio or dedicated delegation allocations are being considered. Offer a conditional 20–120-room band, subject to hotel availability, with rates, release/cancellation terms and a costed transfer concept; do not imply an allocation exists. Ask for the named hotel-contracting manager, official hotel list, eligibility of Founex/Vaud inventory, required stay patterns and any documented unmet demand. Use Ariane Brusselmans for the IAS conference-operations referral and Jeanne Mencier only for appropriate sponsor/delegation introductions. Recheck the released booking inventory after 17 November; if the portfolio is closed and no unmet need exists, move to relationship nurture rather than an active open-sourcing opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is accessible only conditionally as a housing-supplier/delegation prospect. The congress venue is already announced and MCI has already contracted hotel inventory. Supplier additions, Founex eligibility, rates and allocation headroom are unknown. Delegate booking opens 17 November 2026; that does not establish that MCI is currently seeking hotels. YOTEL must not be shown as a confirmed official hotel or as confirmed overflow.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: seek entry into IAS/MCI hotel supplier consideration and a relationship with repeat sponsor/delegation bookers. This may support future locally relevant IAS meetings, but historical rotation does not support forecasting another Geneva flagship edition. No later Geneva destination, hotel RFP, or future local room allocation is verified. Keep future relationship development separate from the confirmed July 2027 congress.
